entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-20
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Warm trimmed publish retains stale deps.json after reachable System.Text.Json API graph changes #56730
  • [aw] Issue Monster Assigner produced no safe outputs #56716

Closed

  • Support for `#:ref` / `#:project` references in Source Generators #54998

PullRequests

Created

  • OpenHarmony: SDK sandbox defaults and build without installers/workloads #56733
  • RID graphs: add the openharmony RID and the crossgen2 mapping #56732
  • Update MTP and MSTest to include read-side pipe disconnect fix #56731
  • Update .NET 11 installer minimum Visual Studio version #56729
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Check each referenced project once in dotnet format #56728
    Servicing-consider
  • Drain watch test process output through stream EOF #56727
  • Fix endpoint tests under compression-like temporary paths #56725
  • [dotnet watch] Reload the project graph for the selected device and runtime identifier #56723
  • [dotnet watch] Align mobile WebSocket authentication with WASM browser tools #56722
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0.3xx' => 'release/10.0.1xx' #56721

Merged

  • Preserve static web asset endpoint task inputs #56726
  • [release/11.0.1xx] Fix dotnet watch shutdown with connected browser tools #56711
    Area-Watch, backport

    Servicing-consider, branding-update
  • Restore validation, cleanup, and tool shims for optimized Native AOT publish #56650
    Servicing-approved
  • Let the Static Web Assets agent inherit the configured model #56682
  • Enable AOT for Microsoft.DotNet.HotReload.Client package #56712
    Area-Watch

Updated

  • Check each referenced project once in dotnet format #56621
  • Stabilize SDK layout metadata and JSON finalization #56704
  • Fix Native AOT CLI localization #56715
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/11.0.1xx' => 'main' #56464
    sdk-diagnostic-docs-needed

    Servicing-approved, 11.0.0
  • Fix Hot Reload on static SSR pages in Blazor Web apps #56644
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Fix SDK test validation reliability #56627
    Servicing-consider
